spec.stack: Node/TypeScript backend (npm run build → dist), deployed to the Azure sandbox VM (52.180.154.225, SSH as mostafa, rsync --checksum) via the SHARED deploy engine shared/infra/deploy_changes.py driven by a per-project delta (deploy-config.json + <project>.config.sh) — identical approach to revealer-6978 / backend-sandbox-rep-2 / rep-4. Control plane only for firewall; everything else SSH as mostafa.
spec.description: SANDBOX ONLY — prepare the DEPLOY SETUP for a NEW small backend on the Azure sandbox VM, reusing the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses. This is labeled 'Second sandbox (rep 6)'. SCOPE NOW: prepare the deploy setup ONLY — DO NOT deploy now. Requirements, verbatim and non-negotiable: (1) Reuse the shared deploy engine (shared/infra/deploy_changes.py) via a per-project delta, exactly like revealer-6978 / backend-sandbox-rep-2 / backend-sandbox-rep-4 — the engine stays shared/generic; only project-specific values live in this project's deploy-config.json and <project>.config.sh. (2) BACKEND-ONLY (no frontend target). (3) migration='none' => this backend must NOT run database migrations on EVERY deploy — NO DB migrate step on any deploy. (4) It uses its OWN folder and OWN data, NO domain, NO nginx changes. (5) Internal port 4200 only (outside the reverse-proxy range). (6) MUST NEVER touch bendcore/organics/django or any production app, DB, config, or nginx; external ports 80/443/22 stay open; never use --delete outside its own sandbox folder. Proposed concrete config values following the rep-2/rep-4 convention (CTO to confirm/adjust): host 52.180.154.225, user mostafa, reboot false, sandbox true, domain null; one 'backend' target — local /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Consolidated/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep6-backend, vm /home/mostafa/sandbox-rep6/backend, port 4200, excludes [".env*","node_modules","dist","logs"], migration 'none', commands ["rm -rf dist && npm run build"]. Deliverables for this task: the project's deploy/ delta files (deploy-config.json and backend-sandbox-rep-6.config.sh) created and validated against the shared engine — NOT an actual deployment. SSH as mostafa with password auth (oth/.cred), rsync --checksum so changed files overwrite by content, verify real exit codes; firewall (if ever needed) only via the control plane to the owner's single current IP. Do not deploy; stop after the setup is prepared.
